# MachForge

> MachForge is an engineering-led CNC manufacturing coordination studio in Shenzhen, providing DFM review, CNC prototyping, and low-volume production support for robotics, UAV, and hardware teams.

MachForge coordinates CNC manufacturing for metal and plastic components from engineering prototypes to low-volume production through vetted manufacturing partners in Shenzhen and the Pearl River Delta, China.

The focus is on manufacturability, DFM review, process and tolerance decisions, supplier coordination, quality control, production follow-up, and reducing manufacturing risk before production begins.

Services include:

- CNC milling and turning
- DFM review and manufacturability support
- CNC prototyping
- Low-volume production
- Supplier coordination and production follow-up
- Quality control and pre-shipment inspection
- Surface finishing

Typical manufacturing capabilities:

- 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis CNC machining
- Prototype quantities from 1 piece
- Low-volume production
- Laser cutting and marking
- Surface treatments including anodizing, PVD, sandblasting, and electropolishing

Typical materials:

- Aluminum: 6061, 7075
- Stainless steel: 304, 316L
- Brass and copper
- Engineering plastics
- Titanium and other materials on request

Typical industries and use cases:

- Robotics
- UAVs
- Hardware products
- Engineering prototypes
- Low-volume hardware production
- Hardware startups needing CNC prototypes before production
- Engineering teams seeking DFM review before machining
- Robotics and UAV teams coordinating precision components in China

Location: Shenzhen, China — supporting projects worldwide.

Contact: grant@machforge.xyz for technical inquiries and quotation requests.
